[values]
0 null: no payload
1 i64: 8 bytes little endian
2 f64: 8 bytes little endian
3 text: u32 len, UTF-8
4 blob: u32 len, bytes
[status]
0 ok: step applies
1 rejected: no state changed; error is Pi's error name and message
2 fatal: discard the handle
[events]
1 open: JSON OpenOptions
2 rows: u16 nReads, (u32 readId, u32 nRows, u8 nCols, value{nRows*nCols})*
3 submit: JSON SubmitEvent
4 model_event: u32 effectId, JSON array of AssistantMessageEvent
5 model_bytes: u32 effectId, u8 phase, bytes
6 tool_progress: u32 effectId, u8 kind, u32 skipped, u32 waitId, bytes
7 tool_done: u32 effectId, u8 outcome, JSON
8 hook_done: u32 effectId, u8 outcome, JSON (completes hook, env, section, deferred and callback effects)
9 phase_done: u32 effectId, u8 outcome, JSON
10 tx: u32 txId, JSON op
11 timer: u32 timerId
12 abort: JSON {taskId} or {conversationId}
13 registry: JSON registry snapshot
14 api: u32 requestId, JSON
15 close: none
16 inspect: JSON query
[effects]
1 timer: u32 timerId, f64 at, u8 durable
2 timer_clear: u32 timerId
3 model_context: JSON ModelContextEffect: {model, context:{messages}, options} or {model, extends, append, options}
4 model_http: JSON head, body recipe
5 cancel: u32 effectId
6 tool: JSON ToolEffect
7 hook: JSON {name, handler, conversationId, taskId, payload}
8 phase: JSON {taskId, kind, phase, record, invocation}
9 env: JSON {conversationId}
10 liveness: f64 at or -1
11 section: JSON {conversationId, taskId, section, input}
12 deferred: JSON {op, model, handle}
13 callback: JSON {name, txId, payload}
[notices]
1 published: JSON
2 api_result: u32 requestId, JSON
3 tx_result: u32 txId, JSON
4 report: JSON
5 sidecar: JSON {conversationId, rows}
6 progress_ack: u32 waitId, u8 outcome, JSON error when rejected
[api]
memo.get(taskId, name) -> the memo value or null; answered at once
memo.put(taskId, name, candidate) -> the durable winner; answered after the memo's commit is applied
snapshot(doc) -> the document state or null; answered at once
snapshotAsOf(doc, seq) -> the document state at seq or null; answered at once
watch.open(doc or graph, watchId) -> the first frame; answered at once; later frames arrive as published notices carrying watchId
watch.close(watchId) -> null; answered at once
getTask(taskId) -> the task record or null; answered at once
waitForTask(taskId) -> the settled receipt; answered when the task is terminal and published
outcomes(taskIds) -> the outcomes in order, or an error naming the missing one; answered at once
entry(conversationId, entryId) -> the entry record or null; answered at once
context(conversationId, at) -> the ContextView; answered at once
conversation(conversationId) -> the conversation handle data or null; answered at once
agent(conversationId) -> the resolved agent; answered at once
sleep(taskId, until) -> null; answered at the wake of the durable timer the core arms
usage() -> the UsageState of the Session; answered at once
taskGraph() -> the TaskGraph; answered at once
[layout]
step := u32 size, u8 status, u16 nCommits, u16 nReads, u16 nNotices, u16 nEffects, commit*, read*, notice*, effect*, [status != 0: u32 len, error JSON]
size and len count the bytes after their own field; the step export returns size + 4
commit := u32 len, i64 seq, u16 nStmts, stmt*
stmt := u16 sqlId, u8 nParams, value*
read := u32 readId, u16 sqlId, u8 nParams, value*
notice := u8 kind, u32 len, payload
effect := u32 effectId, u8 kind, u32 len, payload
rows-event := u16 nReads, (u32 readId, u32 nRows, u8 nCols, value{nRows*nCols})*
model_bytes phase: 0 head, 1 chunk, 2 end, 3 error
tool_progress waitId is always present: nonzero only for kind 1, whose details update is answered by a progress_ack notice
tool_progress kind: 0 output, 1 details, 2 diagnostic
outcome: 0 result, 1 thrown
memStats: 8 x u64: arena, index, derived, documents, scratch, total live, heap in use, linear memory size
